items.difficulty_reason: 64 行（含 15 行陈述）、下 shriek 投影公式：预层层级的纯张量规则 (Z,s)x t -> (Z, s x f^{-1}t) 构造 + 线性扩张，过渡映射与限制相容性由显示规则立得，stalk 图两竖箭头经 stalk 刻画引理辨识、下横箭头为 obvious isomorphism。软点披露：两处 'immediate'（显示规则上的机械检查）与 'obvious isomorphism'（显示图上）——非承重验证省略，无 verbatim omit。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-f-shriek-projection (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 2024-2038

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: work on the presheaf level using the colimit-over-support description of f_{p!}: define the map on pure tensors by (Z, s) tensor t maps to (Z, s tensor f^{-1}t) and extend linearly; the displayed rule makes compatibility with the colimit transition maps and with restrictions immediate; sheafify and check the stalk diagram: the stalks of both sides are identified with the fibre direct sums by the stalk lemma, and under these identifications the stalk of can is the obvious isomorphism, so can is an isomorphism (source lines 2040-2103)
